name: cavemio-progress
title: Progress
description: How far along, as a bar or a ring: the fill eases to each value, the percent rolls, and at 100 it turns green and a check draws itself.

cavemio.accessibility:
- role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow; aria-busy until done.
- Reduced motion: values change in place; the unknown sweep slows.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: label / doneLabel
props.description: – · Above the bar; doneLabel replaces it at 100.
